results.corrected_title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and restricted Mythos 5.2
results.corrected_summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on 2026-11-09 at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. Outputs are up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1. Mythos is not generally available and is limited to vetted applicants in Anthropic's cybersecurity and life-sciences verification programs. Anthropic says about 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in roughly 30 hours, and that the model solved two open black-hole problems. These are company claims, and the physics results come from preprints that have not been externally reviewed.
key_facts: Released 2026-11-09; standard pricing $8/M input and $40/M output tokens
Up to 30% faster than Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1
Mythos 5.2 is available only through the Cyber Verification Program and Life Sciences Verification Program
About 1,000 agents formalized Fermat's Last Theorem in Lean in about 30 hours, given a proof sketch, definitions and 47 earlier lemmas; Anthropic's earlier effort took 11 days
Two open black-hole problems solved using holographic duality per Anthropic's preprints; no external review
results.issues: Confirmation from Anthropic's own page; physics and Fermat results are company claims.

results.corrected_title: AI stocks rebound after a sharp sell-off, with Micron, Broadcom and Nvidia up
results.corrected_summary: On 2026-11-11, AI-linked stocks rebounded after a sharp sell-off the previous week. By mid-morning the S&P 500 was up about 1% and the Nasdaq Composite up 1.6%, with Micron up 11.7%, Broadcom up 5.3% and Nvidia up 3.2%. The sell-off on 2026-11-05 was reported as erasing about $2.5tn from the Nasdaq 100 and pushing the Nasdaq Composite into correction; other outlets gave a different size. A worse-than-expected inflation reading raised expectations of Fed rate hikes.
key_facts: Sell-off on 2026-11-05: about $2.5tn off the Nasdaq 100 per YourStory; Korea Times said more than $2tn
2026-11-11 mid-morning: S&P 500 +1%, Nasdaq Composite +1.6%
Micron +11.7%, Broadcom +5.3%, Nvidia +3.2%, CoreWeave +21.9%
Hot inflation reading raised Fed rate-hike expectations
Fear that Democratic gains could restrict AI data-centre construction was cited as a driver

results.corrected_title: Anthropic adds Claude Sheets and Whiteboards in beta and renames Dashboards to Claude Data
results.corrected_summary: On 2026-11-10, Anthropic announced Claude Sheets, a spreadsheet tool, and Claude Whiteboards, a collaborative brainstorming space, both in beta. Dashboards, which launched in October, was renamed Claude Data and is now available. The tools roll out on web and desktop, count against existing usage limits, and no new prices were announced.
key_facts: Announced 2026-11-10
Claude Sheets and Claude Whiteboards are in beta
Dashboards (launched October) renamed Claude Data and now available
Rolling out on web and desktop
Claude Meetings announced as coming soon
results.issues: Plan access described loosely; 'office suite' is media framing.

results.corrected_title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang resigns as CEO; Colette Kress named interim CEO
results.corrected_summary: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as President, CEO and board member, effective immediately, on 2026-11-11, per an SEC 8-K signed on 2026-11-12. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent CEO, and Harvey C. Jones was named the board's first Chair. This followed an independent board investigation opened on 2026-11-08 into reports linking Huang to a former Megaspeed executive whom US authorities reportedly suspected of working for China. Those allegations are unproven.
key_facts: 8-K: the board accepted Huang's resignation on 2026-11-11, effective immediately; filing signed 2026-11-12
Colette Kress is interim CEO; Harvey C. Jones named Chair
Independent investigation announced 2026-11-08 by independent directors with outside counsel
Probe concerned reports linking Huang to a former Megaspeed executive; allegations unproven
Board said it had no reason to believe US national security or Nvidia proprietary information was compromised
Megaspeed reportedly bought more than $4.8bn of Nvidia chips over two years
results.issues: No source states why he resigned; causal link to probe unconfirmed.
